title: Generator of a triangulated category
statement: Let C be a triangulated category [def-weil-triangulated-category]. An object E of C is a (weak) generator of C if every nonzero object K of C admits an integer n and a nonzero morphism E \to K[n]. A set-indexed family (E_i)_{i\in I} of objects of C whose coproduct \bigoplus_{i} E_i exists in C generates C when \bigoplus_i E_i is a generator.
